source:
Rolf,

I can't remember anything from the fight save the sheer terror at being near something so horrid and powerful. There is no shame in running from a foe you cannot possibly hope to defeat, is there? Maybe ale from the tavern is a good idea, but maybe it is better to conquer your fear once and for all... I hope you can forgive me, but I must defeat this monster, if it takes me the rest of my life.

Wishing you and your ale a hearty good-bye,

Weisman.

deep_observation: 语义：多处与源文相悖或凭空增补。固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/zones/dreadfell/npcs.lua:210-217（define_as="BORFAST"，type=undead/subtype=ghoul，name="Borfast the Broken"）。(1) "Thick skin hangs loosely from this short, shambling form" 指皮肤厚而松垂，译文作「肌肉松弛」，把 skin 换成肌肉。(2) "Tufts of hair sticking out from its chin give evidence of a once magnificent dwarven beard" 指下巴只剩几簇残毛、可据以推断「曾经」壮观的矮人须；译文「浓密胡须」正好反转为茂密，并丢掉 once。(3) "an eyeball drooping low from its socket" 是眼球低垂悬在眼窝外，译文「从它的眼窝中掉了出来」改为脱落；随后 "There is a unique sadness to its eyes"（复数 eyes）被译成「他的独眼」，凭空造出独眼设定。(4) "and a slump of resignation to its gait" 中「步态的颓丧」漏译，仅剩笼统的「透露着深深的无奈」。
source:
Thick skin hangs loosely from this short, shambling form. Tufts of hair sticking out from its chin give evidence of a once magnificent dwarven beard. Half its face seems to have been seared in acid at some point, the flesh melted away from the skull and an eyeball drooping low from its socket. There is a unique sadness to its eyes, and a slump of resignation to its gait.
What proud hero of renown was this before he was condemned to such a terrible fate?
surface_observation: 原文的“松垂厚皮”被错译为“肌肉松弛”，且“曾经壮丽的矮人胡须”被改成据毛发判断其为矮人
target: 在你面前的是一只步履蹒跚、肌肉松弛的——怪物。从他下巴中伸出的浓密胡须以及他的毛发来看，这是一位矮人。看起来他的半边脸曾经被硫酸泼过，血肉从他的脸部脱落，其中一只眼睛从它的眼窝中掉了出来。他的独眼有一种莫名的悲伤，透露着深深的无奈。如此威风的英雄人物怎会落得如此下场？

deep_observation: 跨条一致性：结尾行 "Current Matrix Spell: %s" 译作「当前强化法术：%s」，与同树另两个可同时维持的持续技能撞车。固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/talents/chronomancy/spellbinding.lua 共四个同 type {"chronomancy/spellbinding",1} 的 sustained 天赋：Empower（第22-56行，"Current Empowered Spell"）、Extension（第58-93行，"Current Extended Spell"）、Matrix（第96-129行，"Current Matrix Spell"）、Quicken（"Current Quickened Spell"），四者互不排斥，可分别绑定不同法术并同屏显示。本仓库 mod-tome.lua:22388、22404、22412 把 Empower、Matrix、Quicken 三条统统译为「当前强化法术」，只有 Extension 用了可区分的「当前延展法术」，玩家无法分辨三行分别对应哪种咒缚。Matrix 的天赋名本身已定为「矩阵加速」，末行却不含该标识；另首句自行增补的「强化指定的时空系法术」又与 Empower（能量增幅，唯一真正提升法术强度者）的措辞重合，加重混淆。

This Fortress is designed as a mobile base for the Godslayers - it can fly.

This rugged jacket is the subject of many a rural legend.
Some say it was fashioned by an adventurous mage turned rogue, in times before the Spellblaze, but was since lost.

形形色色的神秘赌徒都声称自己曾穿过它。他们说，失败却活下来，这就是“不可触及”的含义。
